item.subject: Mathematics
item.stem:
The table shows the temperatures at various times on a certain day.

| Time | 6 a.m. | 9 a.m. | Noon | 3 p.m. | 6 p.m. |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| Temperature °C | 12 | 17 | 14 | 18 | 15 |

A graph, without a temperature scale, is drawn. Of the following, which could be the graph that shows the information given in the table?
item.figure_description:
Four line graphs, labeled A, B, C, and D, each with a vertical axis labeled "Temperature (°C)" without numbers or tick marks, and a horizontal axis labeled "Time" with five evenly spaced tick marks labeled "6 a.m.", "9 a.m.", "Noon", "3 p.m.", and "6 p.m.".
- Graph A: The line begins at a low point at 6 a.m., rises to 9 a.m., rises further to a peak at Noon, drops sharply to a low point at 3 p.m., and rises slightly at 6 p.m.
- Graph B: The line begins at a moderate height at 6 a.m., rises to a peak at 9 a.m., drops at Noon, rises to an even higher peak at 3 p.m., and drops at 6 p.m. to a level higher than the value at Noon.
- Graph C: The line starts at a relatively high point at 6 a.m., drops to 9 a.m., rises to a peak at Noon, drops to 3 p.m., and continues downward at 6 p.m.
- Graph D: The line starts at a low point at 6 a.m., rises to 9 a.m., reaches a maximum at Noon, drops at 3 p.m., and drops further at 6 p.m.

slope.instructions: TIMSS scaled this 1-point item with the three-parameter logistic (3PL) model, which TIMSS uses for multiple-choice items, in the calibration "Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2003 data, 2007 bridging data, and 2007 data (eighth-grade mathematics)". What is the item's slope (discrimination) parameter a? A higher a means that the item separates students of lower and higher mathematics ability more sharply. Choose the value closest to it.

location.instructions: TIMSS scaled this 1-point item with the three-parameter logistic (3PL) model, which TIMSS uses for multiple-choice items, in the calibration "Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2003 data, 2007 bridging data, and 2007 data (eighth-grade mathematics)". What is the item's location (difficulty) parameter b? b is on a logit scale on which the students of the calibration average about 0; a higher b means a harder item. Choose the value closest to it.

guessing.instructions: TIMSS scaled this 1-point item with the three-parameter logistic (3PL) model, which TIMSS uses for multiple-choice items, in the calibration "Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2003 data, 2007 bridging data, and 2007 data (eighth-grade mathematics)". What is the item's guessing (lower asymptote) parameter c: the probability that a student of very low ability answers it correctly, such as by guessing among the options? Choose the value closest to it.
